식 $\frac{{}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{0} - {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{1} + {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{2} - \cdots + (-1)^{11}{}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{11}}{(1+x)^{11}}$의 값을 $\mathrm{A}$,

[단답형 1]
식 $\frac{{}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{0} - {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{1} + {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{2} - \cdots + (-1)^{11}{}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{11}}{(1+x)^{11}}$의 값을 $\mathrm{A}$,
식 ${}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{1} + 2 \times {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{2} + 3 \times {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{3} + \cdots + 11 \times {}_{11}\mathrm{C}_{11}$ 의 값을 $\mathrm{B}$라 할 때, $\frac{\mathrm{A+B}}{2^6}$ 의 값을 구하여 정수로 쓰시오. [4.0점]

reasoning: Let S = sum(k=0..11) (-1)^k * C(11,k) = (1-1)^11 = 0. Thus A = S/(1+x)^11 = 0 wherever the displayed denominator is nonzero, i.e. x != -1.
By the binomial theorem, sum(k=0..11) C(11,k)t^k=(1+t)^11. Differentiating and setting t=1 gives B=sum(k=1..11)k*C(11,k)=11*2^10=11264.
independentFreeze.domainAndExistence: For x != -1, A is defined and equals zero; at x=-1, the original displayed quotient is undefined. The prompt supplies no domain restriction on x. Under the usual intended binomial-sum interpretation the requested result is 176, but the literal expression has this excluded point.
